metasystem goal approve · approve goals for execution

  usage   metasystem goal approve G... [--budget BOX]

Without --budget each goal is approved under its own tier's norm box, all goals in one act.
BOX is norm or the complete compact box, for example 1d/10/720m/1/3 (elapsed/attempts/job
  minutes/active jobs/review rounds).
Run it at your enrolled terminal (metasystem system enroll --name NAME enrolls one); --under GRANT
  is a seat's act under a recorded power of attorney.

Options  before or after the target; -- ends them
  --budget BOX                     the box: norm or the complete compact box
  --repo PATH                      the repository, or any directory or file inside it (default: the
                                   current directory) (also --root)
  --json                           print one JSON result instead of text

Advanced
  --id G (repeatable)              a goal to approve (repeatable) (also --goal)
  --under GRANT                    act under this recorded power of attorney
  --by NAME                        the acting person's name; filled from the enrolled terminal's
                                   proof when omitted
  --temporary-human-word WORD      recorded relayed words presented as the human's; resumes
                                   TEMPORARILY
  --review-by DATE                 re-approval date required with --temporary-human-word
  --elapsed-limit DURATION         long form: the elapsed limit, for example 1d or 4h
  --attempt-limit N                long form: the reservation-attempt limit
  --reserved-job-minutes-limit N   long form: the reserved job-minute limit
  --active-job-limit N             long form: the concurrent-job limit
  --review-round-limit N           long form: the critic review-round limit

Examples
  metasystem goal approve verbs-match-intent
  metasystem goal approve goal-a goal-b
  metasystem goal approve verbs-match-intent --budget 1d/10/720m/1/3
